Border Patrol

Comprehensive security solutions tailored to your specific operational requirements.

Industry Needs

Border and coastal defense is critical to overall national security and development. Traditional frontline defense tasks are heavy, with prominent pressure on anti-infiltration and anti-smuggling. The integrated air-ground construction of smart border defense brings important opportunities to enhance prevention and control efficiency. UAVs equipped with high-performance optoelectronic pods can conduct wide-area maritime inspections for full-domain dynamic monitoring. Intelligent optoelectronic turrets serve as border surveillance equipment, featuring visible light and infrared dual-spectrum systems for 24/7 blind-spot-free monitoring, precisely capturing target details and locating suspicious targets in nocturnal environments. Integrating AI algorithms and high-precision control technology, they can lock and track moving targets, filter interference, and realize intelligent "identification-tracking-warning". Working in coordination, they synchronously transmit HD footage, providing precise support for command decisions, acting as powerful tools to safeguard maritime security and combat illegal activities, and helping build an all-around, three-dimensional smart border defense system.

Solution Center

Land-based Maritime Surveillance & Early Warning

Integrating multi-source information such as radar and optoelectronics, and utilizing intelligent analysis and linkage tracking technology, a digital and intelligent maritime defense control system has been established. It overcomes traditional pain points such as single monitoring methods and incomplete perception, achieving all-weather monitoring, automatic early warning, and efficient on-site control to prevent maritime illegal threats.

VIEW DETAILS

UAV Maritime Emergency Rescue

In case of maritime emergencies, accidents, and various incidents, UAVs can respond quickly and fly to the scene immediately, providing real-time panoramic views and situational information for efficient auxiliary decision-making and remote dispatch. They also conduct target searching and personnel positioning, and can be equipped with emergency delivery devices to accurately drop life-saving supplies.

VIEW DETAILS

UAV Maritime Patrol

Routine maritime patrol accurately meets the requirements for precise inspection within fixed police-designated areas, effectively replacing or assisting existing equipment and personnel in routine patrol tasks, significantly reducing the pressure on frontline-duty staff. Equipped with dual-light infrared pods, it achieves all-weather, long-distance real-time monitoring with synchronous data transmission to the command platform. It supports remote task issuance and law enforcement operations such as warning, legal publicity, and site removal using high-altitude loudspeakers, enhancing the intelligence and emergency response capabilities of maritime defense.

VIEW DETAILS
